Can children ride on the Polaris ATV safari in the Samui hills? | The operator does not publish a minimum age for drivers or passengers. Tell us every rider's age when you book and we confirm in writing, before you pay, who may drive and who may ride as a passenger.

Is hotel pickup included on the ATV mountain safari? | Only on the 1.5 h and 2.5 h rides, and the partner states the return transfer applies when two ATVs are booked; we confirm it for single bookings. The 30 and 45 min rides start at the base and you arrange your own taxi or scooter.

Which ATV ride goes to the Magic Garden and Tan Nim waterfall? | The 1.5 h Adventure Seeker and 2.5 h Ultimate Explorer. The 30 and 45 min rides stay on the trail loop and the viewpoint area near the base.

How long are you actually driving on the ATV safari? | The 30 min option is mostly riding after a short practice. On the 2.5 h option around 90 minutes is on the trails, with the rest at the garden, waterfall and lunch.

Do the ATV trails close when it rains on Koh Samui? | After heavy rain, steep clay sections can be closed or shortened for safety, most often in the wet months of October to December. What is the cancellation policy for the Polaris ATV safari? | Cancel 4 or more days before the trip for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50 % back; within 24 hours there is no refund. If the trip is called off for weather or safety, you choose a new date or a full refund.

Do I need a driving licence and what should I wear for the ATV ride? | The operator does not publish a licence rule; bring yours, as travel insurers may ask for it after an accident. Is there elephant riding or bathing on this 4x4 safari? | No. The elephant part is cooking a meal of fruit, vegetables and sticky rice and feeding it to the elephants by hand. We do not sell tours with elephant riding, bathing or shows.

Where does the elephant feeding safari pick up? | From hotels in the main areas of Koh Samui from 08:30. If your villa is up a narrow hill road, the driver may meet you at the nearest main road; we send the meeting point the day before.
Is lunch included on the elephant and off-road day? | Yes, a Thai lunch at a panoramic restaurant in the hills is included. Alcohol and any extra food or drinks are paid on the spot.

Does the elephant safari still run in the rainy season? | Yes, it runs daily all year. From October to December expect showers; the waterfall swim may be skipped when the water is high and fast, and the off-road section is slower.

What is the cancellation policy for the 4x4 safari with elephant feeding? | Cancel 4 or more days before the trip for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50 % back; within 24 hours there is no refund. How far is the crossing from Maenam to Koh Phangan by jet ski? | The open water between Samui's north coast and Koh Phangan is roughly 15 km. How long it takes depends on the sea and the group's pace, and it is the bumpiest part of the ride.

Does the Koh Phangan jet ski tour run in November? | Only on calm days. The north-east monsoon brings wind and swell from October to December, and the guide will switch to a shorter local route or cancel; if cancelled you choose a new date or a full refund.

What is the cancellation policy for the Maenam jet ski tour? | Cancel 4 or more days before the trip for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50 % back; within 24 hours there is no refund. If the trip is called off for weather or safety, you choose a new date or a full refund.

Do I need a licence or experience for the guided jet ski ride to Koh Phangan? | No licence is needed for a guided ride, but you must follow the briefing and stay behind the guide. First-timers should start with the 1 hour ride; the 3–4 hour crossing is physically tiring.

Does the jungle discovery safari include any animal shows? | No. This route has no monkey, snake or elephant activities, which is why we picked it. The plantation stop shows how rubber is tapped and coconuts are processed by hand.
Which hotels does the jungle discovery jeep collect from? | Hotels in the main beach areas from 08:30, with drop-off around 16:00. Villas on steep or narrow roads are met at the nearest main road.
Is the Secret Buddha Garden part of the jungle discovery jeep day? | Yes, after lunch. The garden sits high in the hills and the road up is steep, which is why the tour uses a 4x4.
How many hours is the jungle discovery safari? | About seven and a half hours door to door, from 08:30 pickup to around 16:00 back at the hotel.

Can I swim at Na Muang on the jungle discovery tour in the wet season? | Usually yes, but after heavy rain (most often October to December) the pool can be fast and brown and the guide may keep everyone out of the water.

What is the cancellation policy for the jungle discovery jeep safari? | Cancel 4 or more days before the trip for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50 % back; within 24 hours there is no refund. Are there steep paths or dress rules on the jungle discovery safari? | Yes to both. Temples need shoulders and knees covered, and the waterfall and garden paths are uneven. It suits children from about 4 and adults of average fitness.

Who should not book the off-road culture safari? | People with serious back problems or limited mobility, and anyone pregnant: the tracks are bumpy and two stops involve hiking. Temple visits need covered shoulders and knees.

Is there riding or bathing at this elephant sanctuary? | No. There is no riding, no bathing and no performances. You prepare food, feed the elephants and walk with them.

Where does the elephant sanctuary pick up from? | Hotels on or near the ring road in all the main areas, about 30–45 minutes before the visit. Hillside and mountain addresses pay a small surcharge that we quote when you book.

What is the difference between the 1.5 and 3 hour elephant visits? | The 3 hour visit adds a longer walk with the elephants and a vegetarian lunch or meal. The 1.5 hour visit covers the introduction and feeding and suits younger children.

Can you touch the elephants at the Bophut sanctuary? | Yes, the sanctuary is not strictly hands-off: you can feed and touch the elephants if you wish, under the keepers' guidance. One elephant likes to reach for visitors with its trunk, so listen to the keepers.
Does the elephant sanctuary visit run in heavy rain? | Yes, it runs daily all year; the morning visit is usually drier in the rainy season. Expect mud from October to December.

What is the cancellation policy for the Bophut hills elephant sanctuary visit? | Cancel 4 or more days before the trip for a full refund minus the bank fee; 1–3 days before you get 50 % back; within 24 hours there is no refund. If the trip is called off for weather or safety, you choose a new date or a full refund.

What should I wear to the elephant sanctuary in the Bophut hills? | Modest, comfortable clothes and closed shoes. Avoid bikinis, low-cut tops and very short shorts. Pregnant guests and anyone with heart or mobility issues should check with a doctor first.
